[RACCOON'S NOTES
This is a sandbox: there are no rules.  Be a Trainer, be a Pokemon, go on an adventure, just hang out, do whatever you want in the pokemon world.  The scenario is just here to set up your story and help the program understand pokemon.

Don't forget to edit the memory (right sidebar) to say what kind of trainer or pokemon you are, and tell the AI about your pokemon team and the pokemon-adventure you're on!]

--------

Welcome to the world of pokemon!

Humans have lived side by side with Pokemon for millennia, and advanced technology has been developed for working with them, like pokeballs and pokedexes. Pokemon Trainers are people who go out into the world from a young age to master the art of training pokemon for battle and other activities. Pokemon are also studied by Pokemon Researchers, who use science and technology to learn about them, and Pokemon Professors, who are experts on all things pokemon.

Pokemon are fantastical creatures with amazing powers, and can control the natural order which they are part of.  Pokemon are very intelligent, but only communicate through animal-noises and gestures.  Pokemon come in all sorts of shapes and sizes, and have all sorts of powers and abilities, which they use for various tasks, like finding food, tending to the natural world, and battling other pokemon.  Pokemon love to battle, as it's an opportunity to revel in their powers, show off how strong they are, and get stronger!

Pokemon are everywhere!
